raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the generational relationship. After finding that Zita’s mother was Infanta Maria Antonia of Portugal, WebSurfer looked at Maria Antonia’s parents and incorrectly concluded that her mother, Adelaide of Löwenstein-Wertheim-Rosenberg, was Elisabeth’s maternal grandmother. This conflated the great-grandmother with the grandmother and ignored the established chain (Elisabeth → Zita → Maria Antonia).
